stories.title: Detailhandel – Verführung am Regal – darum verkaufen sich Lebensmittel gut

en.title: Retail - Temptation at the shelf - why food products sell well
en.summary: Coop opened its 1000th store in Emmen. The chain's expansion and focus on fresh products reflect current retail trends.

stories.title: Gletscherschmelze in den Alpen – So zeigt sich der Gletscherschwund auf der Karte

en.title: Glacier melting in the Alps - How glacier decline appears on the map
en.summary: Alpine glaciers lost significant ice during summer heat. These changes are now reflected in updated cartographic representations.

stories.title: CIPS versus Swift – China greift Dominanz von Dollar an – vor allem in Afrika

en.title: CIPS versus Swift - China challenges dollar dominance - especially in Africa
en.summary: China is developing its own global payment system using the yuan as currency. The system aims to reduce the country's dependence on the dollar.

stories.title: 25 Jahre Swissair-Grounding – Ex-Pilot: «Die Swissair kann man nicht vergessen»

en.title: 25 years of Swissair grounding - Ex-pilot: "You cannot forget Swissair"
en.summary: Swissair became insolvent 25 years ago, leaving thousands of passengers stranded worldwide. Two witnesses share their accounts of the event.

stories.title: Deux tiers des Suisses s’opposent à l’achat des F-35, selon un sondage de l’institut Leewas

en.title: Two-thirds of Swiss oppose F-35 purchase, according to Leewas institute poll
en.summary: A survey of 10,000 people found that 65% of Swiss respondents oppose purchasing American F-35 fighter jets, while 28% support the acquisition. Opposition spans all age groups, with stronger rejection among Socialist and Green party supporters.

stories.title: Polémique sur Notre-Dame d'Aparecida et débat TV avorté: dernière ligne droite avant la présidentielle au Brésil

en.title: Controversy over Our Lady of Aparecida and cancelled TV debate: final stretch before Brazilian presidential election
en.summary: Brazil's presidential campaign enters its final days amid tensions, with a planned televised debate cancelled and disputes over religious symbolism and alleged misuse of American public funds occurring just before Sunday's first round.

stories.title: Die SVP ist muff – sie hält die Idee einer EU-Abstimmung im Juni 2027 für reine Wahltaktik

en.title: The SVP is unimpressed—it considers the idea of an EU vote in June 2027 to be pure electoral tactics
en.summary: A disagreement between SVP foreign policy representative Franz Grüter and FDP counterpart Simon Michel reveals that disputes over EU treaties are becoming intertwined with political calendar maneuvering.

stories.title: Le géant américain du jouet Mattel se lance dans les parcs aquatiques

en.title: American toy giant Mattel ventures into water parks
en.summary: Mattel announced plans to diversify beyond toys by building five indoor water parks across the United States, with the first opening in Nebraska by late 2027, showcasing brands like Barbie and Hot Wheels.

stories.title: Une enquête indépendante est demandée sur le département de Maudet

en.title: Independent investigation requested into Maudet department
en.summary: Geneva's Grand Council is calling for an independent investigation into controversial recruitment practices within Pierre Maudet's Department of Health and Mobility, while the official disputes the matter as politically motivated.

stories.title: Le Grand Conseil genevois veut une enquête indépendante sur le Département de la santé de Pierre Maudet

en.title: Geneva's Grand Council wants independent investigation into Pierre Maudet's Health Department
en.summary: Geneva lawmakers overwhelmingly approved a motion calling for an independent inquiry into alleged hiring favoritism and workplace issues within the cantonal health office, following media reports of controversial recruitment practices.

stories.title: Après l’imposition individuelle, un comité féminin repart en campagne pour les couples mariés

en.title: After individual taxation, a women's committee launches campaign for married couples' taxation
en.summary: A multi-party women's committee launched a campaign Thursday for a ballot initiative on joint taxation of married couples, scheduled for a November vote following March's individual taxation approval.

stories.title: Un comité lance une nouvelle campagne pour supprimer la pénalisation fiscale du mariage

en.title: Committee launches new campaign to remove tax penalty on marriage
en.summary: A cross-party committee began campaigning on Thursday for a November 29 ballot initiative aimed at ending the tax disadvantage faced by married couples in Switzerland, following a March vote that endorsed the principle of individual taxation.

stories.title: Mario Draghi fordert in Zürich eine stärkere europäische Integration: «Das alte Wachstumsmodell funktioniert nicht mehr»

en.title: Mario Draghi calls for stronger European integration in Zurich: "The old growth model no longer works"
en.summary: Former European Central Bank President Mario Draghi addressed ETH Zurich, arguing that Europe must unlock new sources of growth and outlining how this could be achieved through stronger integration.

stories.title: Open AI ist eine Billion Dollar wert – doch in Zürich hat sich der Konzern nun als Kleinfirma eingetragen

en.title: Open AI is worth one trillion dollars – but in Zurich it registered as a small company
en.summary: Despite hopes that OpenAI and Anthropic could grow to the scale of Meta or Google, an analysis of job postings and business registrations shows both companies have experienced minimal growth in Switzerland.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - Das Swissair-Grounding und die Schweiz: «Das Misstrauen gegenüber der Wirtschaftselite ist bis heute nicht verschwunden»

en.title: INTERVIEW - The Swissair collapse and Switzerland: "Mistrust of the business elite has not disappeared to this day"
en.summary: Economic historian Tobias Straumann describes Swissair's October 2, 2001 collapse as emblematic of Switzerland's broader economic decline, resulting in a lasting division between the public and the business establishment.

stories.title: «Präventivschläge gegen Entscheidungszentren»: Russland droht für den Fall eines Nato-Angriffs mit Atomwaffen

en.title: "Preventive strikes against decision centers": Russia threatens nuclear weapons in case of NATO attack
en.summary: Russia accuses NATO of wanting to separate its Kaliningrad exclave but has provided no evidence. NATO Secretary General Rutte responded with calm to the threat.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - «Das radikal Neue ist, dass die politischen Raubtiere unserer Zeit von den Tech-Giganten aus dem Silicon Valley unterstützt werden»

en.title: INTERVIEW - "What is radically new is that today's political predators are supported by tech giants from Silicon Valley"
en.summary: Bestselling author and government advisor Giuliano da Empoli discusses the hidden concerns of powerful figures, current global chaos, and identifies who bears responsibility for a major 21st century failure.
